title: Colored-Noise-Induced Horizon Fluctuations Near a Double Root in an Effective Black-Hole Geometry
summary: Stress-tensor fluctuations carry information that is absent from the mean semiclassical Einstein equation, but their observable effect depends as much on the response of the geometry as on the noise itself. We formulate an effective, quasistationary spherical model organized by the response--noise structure of a quantum Langevin equation. A prescribed mean dressing and a horizon-localized colored source are varied independently.
